verdict.rationale: Stripe's versioning docs say each monthly API release contains only backward-compatible changes, so integrations can safely upgrade without breaking existing code. Snapshot events are versioned, and thin events are described as simplifying the upgrade process. However, the evidence never shows a documented deprecation policy (timelines, sunset notices, or support windows for old versions), which is half of the story. Missing for 10: an explicit documented deprecation/sunset policy, detail on how major (breaking) versions are handled and pinned, and independent corroboration.
